## HEIDMAR MARITIME HOLDINGS CORP. GROWS MANAGED FLEET WITH FIVE STRATEGIC CRUDE TANKER ADDITIONS AMID RECORD MARKET CONDITIONS


May 19, 2026


Athens / New York, 19 May 2026 – Heidmar Maritime Holdings Corp. (the “Company” or”Heidmar”) (NASDAQ: HMR) announces the addition of ﬁve vessels to its commercially managed ﬂeet, further strengthening its position as a leading commercial and pool management operator in the global crude tanker sector.[Read More](https://www.heidmar.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/HEIDMAR-MARITIME-HOLDINGS-CORP.-GROWS-MANAGED-FLEET-WITH-FIVE-STRATEGIC-CRUDE-TANKER-ADDITIONS-AMID-RECORD-MARKET-CONDITIONS.pdf)
